title: The Number of Solutions to $ax+by+cz=n$ for Fibonacci and Lucas triplets
summary: In this work we develop exact formulas to the number of solutions of $ax+by+cz=n$ in some special cases. In 2020, Binner gave a formula for the number of non negative integer solutions, $N(a,b,c;n)$ in non-negative integer pairs $(x,y,z),$ of the equation $ax+by+cz=n$ assuming that $a,b,c$ and $n$ are natural numbers. However, his formula was in summations of floor functions. Moreover, he gave a reciprocity relation to solve these sums by generalising the Gauss reciprocity relation.
